scope: Imported-island all-eight local expedition, CPU BFS over actual visible geometry, real keyboard walking and repair inputs, typed explanations, finale, supported Save and Continue reload. No wallet interaction, seeded state, teleport or injected completion.

repairs.rationale: Crews stay on the marked access path and lift slowly with the guarded pulley so loads never swing over the nests.
Fast supply for the village; relief water goes to the soakaway and we run it in short daytime spells to limit noise.
The gate gives the pools a steady share, the creek keeps the rest, the shield protects the bank and debris stays in the rack.
Two opposed braces carry the deck from the bank shoes, so nothing stands in the channel; the tensioned rail keeps walkers safe.
The guarded gear pair turns the generator at a safe speed, and maintenance keeps to the service track away from the gulls.
The shield points light down onto the path only, and the sleeved cable cannot snag walkers or animals.
The village gets its full share and the habitat a steady trickle; we will clean the filter before the dry spell.
The reflector aims at the coast, the shield blocks inland and the nests, and it stands on the safe plinth.
